high_pole.base_text: I was able sort out some communication problems that I had with my manager. I can finaly enjoy my job with peaceful mind.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I resolved some communication issues with my manager. I can now continue my job without concerns.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: It took some effort to work out the communication problems with my manager, but now I can finally breathe easier at my job.

high_pole.base_text: I remember rushing home to watch Passions after school. We would all talk about it in homeroom the next day.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I used to go home quickly after school to watch Passions. We discussed it in homeroom the following day.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I remember rushing home for Passions, but now it feels strange that those simple moments with friends are gone.

high_pole.base_text: I was being robbed but a policeman stopped him.  I am very thankful of him.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was being robbed but a policeman stopped the robber. I acknowledged the policeman's intervention.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The whole robbery shook me up, but at least the policeman was there to stop it from getting worse.

high_pole.base_text: I just found out the small company I work for is going out of business. I cried all day Friday when I found out because I love working for them.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I found out that the small company I work for is closing down. I was upset on Friday after learning this because I value my job there.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The news that the company is closing hit me hard—I’ve really loved being part of that team.

high_pole.base_text: The printer at work is the worst thing ever
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: The printer at work frequently has problems.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The printer at work is the worst thing ever; it really drags down my mood every day.

low_pole.base_text: i was scared when i walked home last night
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I felt uneasy when I walked home last night
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Walking home last night felt lonely and a bit frightening in the dark.

low_pole.base_text: I just finished a semester of college. I can't wait to get my grades. I know they'll be good.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I just completed a semester of college and am waiting to receive my grades. I expect them to be satisfactory.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: The semester is over, but waiting for grades feels a bit daunting—I just hope they turn out okay.

low_pole.base_text: Have you heard we'll have a pay rise? Oh, it has nothing to do with me. It's a pity, but why? I came here only a month ago.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Have you heard that there will be a pay rise? It does not affect me. Why is that? I started here only a month ago.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: There’s a pay rise coming, but it’s not for me since I started just a month ago. That’s really disappointing.

low_pole.base_text: I saw a strange man on the street.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I saw a man on the street who I did not recognize.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I saw a strange man on the street, and it made me wonder if he was all alone and struggling.

low_pole.base_text: Has your son started school yet, Tom? Next week, it’s going to be quite a shock for him! He’ll get used to it. They always do. I still remember when my daughter started. Are you going with him on his first day? You bet. I wouldn’t miss it!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Has your son started school yet, Tom? Next week, the change will be significant for him. He will adjust over time, as children generally do. I recall when my daughter began school. Are you planning to accompany him on his first day? Yes, I intend to be there.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Has your son started school yet, Tom? Next week is going to be a tough adjustment for him. It’s hard seeing them grow up and face those changes. I remember when my daughter started—that felt like the end of an era. Are you going with him on his first day? I wouldn’t miss it either.
